prompt: who won the formula one season in the year nine people were killed on the track at the argentine grand prix, and how old were they two years before sliced bread was first sold?
answer:
The 1953 Argentine Grand Prix tragedy killed nine spectators. The 1953 Formula One World Championship was won by **Alberto Ascari**.

Sliced bread was first commercially sold in **1928**, so two years earlier was **1926**. Ascari, born on July 13, 1918, was **7 years old then—turning 8 that year**.
